description: See who is endorsing Rep. Josiah Hill for re-election to the Minnesota House, District 33B. Josiah Hill has earned endorsements from organizations including Planned Parenthood Minnesota and the Minnesota Association of Professional Employees (MAPE), along with support from community leaders, labor groups, and advocacy organizations across the St. Croix Valley. This page is updated regularly as new endorsements come in.
